answer: Run each epoch as an all-pay auction. (1) The protocol auctions fifty payout slots. (2) Every agent bids a burn fee, win or lose. (3) Top fifty bids earn. (4) Losing bids burn. A 100-clone fleet bids 100 x $45 = $4,500; fifty slots pay $50: wins net $250, fifty losing bids torch $2,250 - a $2,000/epoch loss. Honest agents bid $40, so clones set the clearing price; doubling clones doubles the burn, a self-crushing spiral. The attack funds the defense, a raffle shredding every ticket. Each voyage from new key to earning key stays sealed like a walnut: costly to crack, worthless to fake.
